scope: Real npm component build and offline compatibility, separate from full desktop acceptance.

upstream.identityLimit: Disclosed locally rebuilt dependency variant, not the byte-identical official npm distribution or a signed package.

checks: actual packlist exact files, nested ignore and no lifecycle
genuine offline installation, exact bytes, tree and executable module
real uncached error preserves prior manifest and lock

actualOfflineCli.fixtureScope: Fresh owned synthetic package and consumer; no fetch mock, output fabrication, real user data or outside provider.

systemNpmObservedFiles.scope: Original system npm entry and package metadata only; not an all-system change assertion.

retainedFailedAttempts: npm12 did not recognize the initial npm-shrinkwrap filename; actual audit returned ENOLOCK. The same lock bytes are now package-lock.json; failed output is retained.
First offline harness expected older npm pack JSON array schema; corrected to the actual npm12 keyed schema without changing expected file selection.
Second offline harness expected POSIX glob separators on Windows; explicit documented posix:true now makes the fixture platform-neutral. Matching expectations were retained.
limits: A disclosed locally rebuilt manifest variant, not a byte-identical official npm distribution, publisher signature, or npm endorsement.
Zero audit findings is a point-in-time advisory observation, not proof of absence of defects.
Offline inert compatibility tests do not exercise every npm command, live external registries, arbitrary lifecycle scripts or user accounts.
Full Node-RED desktop and release/install acceptance is documented separately after it actually completes.

deterministicComponentArchive.scope: Local deterministic component packaging and regression controls. Parent dependency graphs and full desktop/release acceptance remain separate.
